title: Weeknight Chicken Fajitas
description: Smoky, charred chicken and peppers wrapped in warm tortillas, ready in half an hour.

items: 1 1/2 lb boneless chicken thighs, sliced into strips
Sour cream, salsa and cilantro, to serve
Toss the chicken with the spice rub ingredients and let it sit while you slice the vegetables.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat until shimmering. Cook the chicken in a single layer, without stirring, for 3 minutes, then stir and cook 3–4 minutes more until charred and cooked through. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, peppers and onion to the pan. Cook 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened with charred edges.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss for 1 minute to combine.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven, then serve with the filling and toppings.

notes: Thighs stay juicier than breasts at high heat, but breasts work if sliced thin.
